goal: Make every doc in the repo an accurate description of what the code actually does today, audited and remediated per consumer persona, with guardrails so it stops drifting.

phases.goal: A ground-truth inventory exists that says, per doc and per persona, exactly which claims are still true, which are stale, and which are missing — so remediation is driven by evidence instead of vibes.
definition_of_done: cmd: test -f docs/audit/inventory.md && test -f docs/audit/drift-report.md
cmd: bash scripts/audit/extract-routes.sh | head -1
cmd: bash scripts/audit/extract-config-keys.sh | head -1
grep: End user in docs/audit/inventory.md
grep: Operator in docs/audit/inventory.md
grep: API in docs/audit/inventory.md
grep: Contributor in docs/audit/inventory.md
grep: AI coding agent in docs/audit/inventory.md
grep: Decision reader in docs/audit/inventory.md

prose: every item in drift-report.md cites BOTH a doc file:line and the contradicting code file:line or command output — no unevidenced assertions. Spot-check at least 5 items by re-running the cited evidence.

phases.goal: An end user can follow README/QUICKSTART/user-guide start to finish and have every step match what the app actually does.
definition_of_done: cmd: markdownlint-cli2 --config .markdownlint.yaml README.md QUICKSTART.md docs/user-guide.md docs/user-interface-overview.md
cmd: lychee --scheme file --include-fragments --config .lychee.toml README.md QUICKSTART.md docs/user-guide.md docs/user-interface-overview.md
grep:absent: TODO|FIXME|TBD in README.md QUICKSTART.md docs/user-guide.md
prose: every shell command shown in these four docs was executed (or explicitly dry-run justified) and produced the documented result — list each command and its outcome in the PR body.
prose: every end-user-tagged item in docs/audit/drift-report.md is either fixed here or explicitly deferred with a written reason.

phases.goal: An operator can stand up and configure the system from the docs alone, with every config key, env var, and compose service matching reality.
definition_of_done: cmd: bash scripts/audit/extract-config-keys.sh > /tmp/keys.txt && while read -r k; do grep -q "$k" docs/configuration-reference.md || { echo "UNDOCUMENTED: $k"; exit 1; }; done < /tmp/keys.txt
cmd: markdownlint-cli2 --config .markdownlint.yaml docs/setup-guide.md docs/deployment-guide.md docs/oauth-setup-guide.md docs/configuration-reference.md
cmd: lychee --scheme file --include-fragments --config .lychee.toml docs/setup-guide.md docs/deployment-guide.md docs/oauth-setup-guide.md docs/configuration-reference.md
cmd: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config -q
cmd: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config -q
prose: every service name, published port, and required secret named in the operator docs was cross-checked against the compose files — cite the compose line for each.

phases.goal: The documented API and MCP surface matches what the server actually exposes, closing the ~124-routes-vs-12-documented gap.
definition_of_done: cmd: python3 -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('docs/api/openapi.yaml')); sys.exit(0 if d.get('paths') else 1)"
cmd: bash scripts/audit/extract-routes.sh | wc -l
cmd: test -f docs/audit/api-coverage.md

prose: docs/audit/api-coverage.md reports documented-vs-actual route coverage as a number, and every undocumented route is either now documented or listed in the deliberate-exclusion allowlist with a reason.
prose: at least 8 documented endpoints had their request/response shape verified against the actual handler code — cite handler file:line for each.

phases.goal: A contributor can navigate the architecture, build, test, and release process from the docs without hitting a stale instruction.
definition_of_done: cmd: markdownlint-cli2 --config .markdownlint.yaml docs/maintainer-guide.md docs/architecture.md docs/releasing.md
cmd: lychee --scheme file --include-fragments --config .lychee.toml docs/maintainer-guide.md docs/architecture.md docs/releasing.md
prose: every module/directory path named in docs/architecture.md exists — list each path and confirm with a filesystem check.
prose: the release steps in docs/releasing.md match the actual job graph in .github/workflows/release.yml — cite job names and their needs: edges.
prose: every contributor-tagged drift item is fixed or explicitly deferred with a reason.

phases.goal: The agent-facing instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) and the historical decision records are accurate, with superseded decisions annotated rather than silently rewritten.
definition_of_done: cmd: markdownlint-cli2 --config .markdownlint.yaml CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md 'docs/ADRs/*.md' 'docs/DDDs/*.md'
cmd: lychee --scheme file --include-fragments --config .lychee.toml CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md
grep:absent: Bundlewatch CI gate in docs/ADRs/ADR-005-tauri-to-web-spa-migration.md
prose: every command or path asserted in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md was verified to exist/run — list each with its result.
prose: no ADR's original Decision or Context text was rewritten; corrections are additive notes only. Show the diff shape for each ADR touched.

phases.goal: Docs cannot silently drift again — CI fails when a doc contradicts the code, without becoming a gate so brittle it blocks unrelated PRs.
definition_of_done: grep: docs in .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/docs-accuracy.yml
cmd: test -f docs/audit/README.md
cmd: bash scripts/audit/extract-config-keys.sh >/dev/null && bash scripts/audit/extract-routes.sh >/dev/null
cmd: yamllint -c .yamllint.yaml .github/

prose: the new gate was proven to FAIL on a deliberately introduced contradiction (show the failing run or a local reproduction), then pass once reverted — an unproven gate is theater, which is exactly what the ci-build-optimization pipeline just removed.
prose: the gate's failure message tells a contributor exactly which doc contradicts which code location and how to fix or re-baseline it.

skipped: infra_up (not needed -- no runtime/service code touched this phase)
test_integration (optional; docs/scripts-only phase, no backend runtime change)
test_frontend (redundant -- frontend vitest already ran as part of Tier 1 'test': 204/204 passed)
summary: Ground-truth doc inventory (92 tracked docs, 6 personas) + evidence-backed drift report (74 findings: 20 breaks-a-user/43 misleading/11 cosmetic; 7 personally spot-checked). Built extract-routes.sh (resolves nest/merge/route -> 137 real paths) and extract-config-keys.sh (yaml+env keys) as the reusable phase-6 CI drift gate. Tier-3 review caught the drift-report's own summary table miscounting itself -- fixed.

skipped: build/test/test_integration (docs-only diff: README.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/user-interface-overview.md, .autopilot/discovered/*.jsonl -- zero backend/frontend source touched, confirmed via git diff --stat)
summary: Fixed all 15 end-user drift-report findings across README.md/user-guide.md/user-interface-overview.md (QUICKSTART.md had none): removed 10 invented keyboard shortcuts (kept 4 real + 2 found during verification), rewrote Privacy settings to stop implying working encryption/audit-log, corrected AI Settings default+Gemini claim, Rules condition fields, Quick Actions, compose-editor and chat-model claims, README TS version. Verified every doc command against justfile/scripts. Tier-3 caught 2 real defects in my own fixes (a replacement false claim, an understated known-issue) -- both corrected. Deferred: Rules JSON-contract bug and a broken cargo-outdated wrapper, both logged as parking-lot (out of scope for docs-only).

skipped: infra_up (not needed -- docs-only phase, no runtime service required to verify claims)
build/test/test_integration (docs-only diff + 2 DoD-command fixes in pipeline.yml; zero backend/frontend source touched, confirmed via git diff --stat)
summary: Fixed all 16 operator drift-report findings (setup/deployment/oauth guides): OAuth callback URIs, PostgreSQL-not-connectable, wrong LLM model id/sizes, configs/ path, cloud API-key var names, Make->just. Reconciled configuration-reference.md against all 156 real config keys: replaced a 5-fictional-model table with the real 16-model catalog, added rate_limit/hsts/oauth.frontend_url + raw env vars, added a new 70-key Application Settings (app.yaml) section, fixed generative default + missing openrouter provider. Verified every compose service/port/secret; both docker compose config -q pass. Fixed 2 unsatisfiable DoD commands in pipeline.yml itself (key-coverage prefix mismatch, dev-compose-as-overlay). Tier-3 caught 1 remaining inaccuracy (openrouter framed as a cloud sub-option) -- fixed.
